def.brief: Narrow fix in judge consume's reviewed gate (hunsu.py, judge_consume, around 'the judge says the resolution still fits'): when a changed situation's resolution has reviewed exactly false and the verdict is a grounded still-fits, keep reviewed: false — no delegation record — and say in consume's output that the judge found it still fits but no person has read the proposal, so it stays unreviewed. Every other case keeps today's behavior: a previously reviewed resolution (true, {by}, no reviewed record, {delegated}) gets the delegation record on a grounded still-fits; negative, ungrounded or state-bound verdicts mark false. No new manifest field, no change to raw judge answers or other records, nothing else in hunsu.py. test_hunsu.py is protected; hostcall.py stays byte-identical; no version bump; never touch a plugin cache, ~/.claude or ~/.codex. Run the tests the change touches (the check below); the full suite is run once at the end of this run, in both contexts
